## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for behaviour changes (`uv run pytest`)
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run ruff format --check .` and `uv run mypy` pass
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` for user-visible changes
- [ ] README or `docs/` updated where the behaviour or the installation changed
- [ ] No voice models, user configuration, logs or audio samples added to the repository
- [ ] The IPC protocol is unchanged, or the change is described above
